name: Pacific & Indian cyclones
summary: Cyclone Akvan under GDACS orange alert; IMD expects landfall between Nellore and Tuni around noon on 20 Nov
state: GDACS kept an orange alert for Tropical Cyclone Akvan, affecting India, at 05:40 UTC on 19 Nov (GDACS). IMD said on 16 Nov it is likely to cross the Andhra Pradesh coast between Nellore and Tuni as a very severe cyclonic storm around noon on 20 Nov, with winds of 120–130 km/h gusting to 145 km/h; Odisha began early evacuations (The Federal). It is Andhra's third cyclone in three weeks (Siasat).
for_you: People in coastal Andhra Pradesh, Odisha and Tamil Nadu should follow IMD and state disaster authority warnings; travellers should check FCDO advice for India.

why: Typhoons and cyclones are the deadliest weather events, threatening densely populated coasts in Asia and the Indian Ocean.
drivers: Ocean heat, ENSO phase, season (W Pacific peaks Jul–Oct; N Indian Apr–Jun & Oct–Dec).

rubric.alert: GDACS red cyclone alert, or a super-typhoon/severe cyclone landfall on a populated coast.
rubric.watch: GDACS orange cyclone alert, or a typhoon/cyclone threatening land within 72h.
rubric.normal: No GDACS orange/red tropical cyclone alerts.
